example.before: (word ) {A sentence with period. } [word (another one ) ] "(test )" the quotation mark may change due to selected langauge) ("test" ) the quotation mark may change due to selected langauge) (λέξη ) {Μια πρόταση με τελεία. } [λέξη (και άλλη μια ) ] “(δείγμα )” the quotation mark may change due to selected langauge) (“δείγμα” ) the quotation mark may change due to selected langauge)
example.after: (word) {A sentence with period.} [word (another one)] “(test)” (the quotation mark may change due to selected langauge) (“test”) the quotation mark may change due to selected langauge) (λέξη) {Μια πρόταση με τελεία.} [λέξη (και άλλη μια)] “(δείγμα)” the quotation mark may change due to selected langauge) (“δείγμα”) the quotation mark may change due to selected langauge)

rule.name: Remove extra spaces after opening parenthesis or brackets
rule.description: Parentheses or brackets are not separated from the expressions they contain by spaces

rule.name: Remove extra spaces after opening quotation marks
rule.description: Expressions in quotation marks are always written without spaces after the opening quotation marks

rule.name: Nonbreaking space in Dutch postal codes #### AA
rule.description: A nonbreaking space should be used between groups of characters of the postal code to prevent them from being split at the end of a line

example.before: 1000 AP Amsterdam (Dutch) 2611 EV Delft (Dutch)

rule.name: Preferred form of space between value and percent symbol (20%)
rule.description: Preferred form of space is used between the value and symbol %

example.before: Ongeveer 20 % van de werknemers (voorheen 15 %) werkt tegenwoordig vanuit huis.
example.after: Ongeveer 20% van de werknemers (voorheen 15%) werkt tegenwoordig vanuit huis.

rule.name: Insert narrow space after asterisk before year or date to express born in (* 1974)
rule.description: Insert narrow space after asterisk before year or date to express born in (* 1974)

rule.name: No space after asterisk before year or date to express born in (* 1974)
rule.description: No space after asterisk before year or date to express born in (* 1974)

example.before: Jan (* 1974) Georg [* 1-11-1974] (Dutch) Lucia (* april 1776)

rule.name: Insert narrow space after dagger before year or date in various formats († 12. 9. 2004)
rule.description: Insert narrow space after dagger before year or date in various formats († 12. 9. 2004, † 12-09-2004…)

rule.name: No space after dagger before year or date († 12. 9. 2004)
rule.description: No space after dagger before year or date († 12. 9. 2004)

rule.name: Remove space between word and symbol (typically trade mark ™ and registered ®)
rule.description: Symbols following words (™, ® etc.) are written directly without a space

example.before: Company ™ Coca-Cola ®

rule.name: Replace ø by diameter sign ⌀ (U+2300) and nonbreaking space before length units
rule.description: Replace ø by diameter sign ⌀ (U+2300) and nonbreaking space before value and length units

rule.name: Nonbreaking space between symbols and numbers incl. Roman numerals (§ XIV or № 14)

example.before: § XIV № 14 ℮ 200 kg Kus à 24 Kč (Czech) Sinaasappels à 24 gulden (Dutch)
example.after: § XIV № 14 ℮ 200 kg Kus à 24 Kč (Czech) Sinaasappels à 24 gulden (Dutch)

rule.name: Remove space between numerical value and certain symbols (5°)
rule.description: No space between numbers and symbols (with the exception of °C and °F)

example.before: Angles: The angle is 45 °. Inches: The monitor size is 27 ″. Feet: The height of the building is 150 ′. Telescope aperture diameter: 8 ″ Seconds of Arc: The precise location is 15 ° 30 ′ 45 ″. The carpenter cut a 24 ″ by 36 ″ wooden board. The temperature is 100 °C (no change)

Telescope aperture diameter: 8″ Seconds of Arc: The precise location is 15° 30′ 45″. rule.name: Correct form of degree Celsius/Fahrenheit

rule.name: Basic mathematical operations with spaces around operators incl. multiply

rule.name: Superior ² after length units – area

rule.name: Alert: two capital letters at the beginning of a word
rule.description: Two capital letters are not written consecutively at the beginning of a sentence or certain words. However, exceptions may be made for company names, product names, service names, or intentional neologisms.

example.before: EXample of the PRoblem. (Incorrect English) Example of the Problem. (Correct English)

rule.name: Alert: two consecutive identical parentheses or brackets
rule.description: Two identical parentheses in a row are usually incorrect; one of them may be superfluous. However, they may be secondary parentheses, which should have a different form. Or perhaps everything is fine in this particular context.

example.before: (Almost.)) (Incorrect English) (Almost.) (Correct English) ((Almost.) (Incorrect English) (Almost.) (Correct English)

rule.description: A word followed by hyphen could be intentional (Ein- oder Zweizimmerwohnung) or the hyphen could represent dash or hyphen with or without spaces depending on context and language.
